scenario: LGRA.2.9.6.8 / .6.2 — an unknown binding in an `emit` String-slot value is a compile error (DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_BINDING). Pin: `{nope}` references no LHS binding; the String slot `argv` is interpolated.
rules_ds:
schema Src scope logical:
    obj: String key

schema Step scope logical:
    argv: String key

rule r:
    Src
->
    emit Step logical argv: "x {nope} y"
